name: Woodwork

oneOf.description: A box with a top, shelves, doors or drawers.

shelves.description: Shelves in each compartment, evenly spaced.

drawers.title: Drawers
drawers.description: Equal drawers, boxes for 12.7 mm slides. No shelves then; not with doors or dividers.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: 0 for none. The plinth board sits 50 mm back from the front.

shelf_pins.description: 32 mm system: rows of 5 mm holes 37 mm from the front and back. The shelves rest on them.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Doors with 35 mm hinge cups: 0, 1, 2, or one per compartment.

door_hinge.description: The next doors alternate. Two always open from the middle.
